recipes.title: Shakshuka with Spiced Tomato Sauce
recipes.description: Poached eggs nestled in fragrant North African spiced tomato sauce, served with crusty bread.
instructions: Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 medium diced onion and sauté over medium heat for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in 3 minced garlic cloves and cook over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add 400g canned tomatoes, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, and 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper; simmer over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper, then create 4 wells in the sauce and crack 4 eggs into them.
Cover and simmer over medium-low heat for 6 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks remain runny.
Garnish with 2 tbsp fresh cilantro and serve with 2 slices toasted bread.

recipes.title: Spanish Chorizo & Potato Tortilla
recipes.description: Thick, custardy Spanish omelette with crispy potatoes, chorizo, and onions—sliced into wedges.
instructions: Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a 25cm non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add 400g thinly sliced potatoes and 1 medium sliced onion; cook over medium heat for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender.
Add 120g sliced chorizo to the pan and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes until edges are slightly crisp.
Whisk together 6 eggs, 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp black pepper in a bowl.
Pour egg mixture over potatoes and chorizo, distributing evenly; cook over medium heat for 3 minutes without stirring.
Heat remaining 2 tbsp olive oil in a small bowl and gently lift edges of tortilla with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to reach the pan; cook over medium heat for 2 more minutes.
Place a large plate over the skillet and invert the tortilla onto it over medium-low heat to flip.
Slide the flipped tortilla back into the skillet and cook over medium-low heat for 2 minutes until the other side is set but still slightly creamy in the center.
Transfer to a cutting board, let cool for 2 minutes, garnish with 2 tbsp chopped parsley, and cut into 4 wedges.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Spiced Shakshuka with Labneh Toast
recipes.description: Poached eggs in fragrant tomato sauce with cumin and coriander, served on creamy labneh.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a wide skillet over medium-high heat.
Sauté 1 medium diced red onion for 3 minutes over medium-high heat until softened.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp ground coriander, and 1/4 tsp chili flakes; stir for 1 minute over medium heat.
Pour in 400g canned diced tomatoes and simmer over medium heat for 8 minutes until sauce thickens.
Create 4 small wells in the sauce and crack 4 large eggs into each well; cover and simmer 5 minutes over medium-low heat until whites set.
Toast 2 slices sourdough bread in a toaster or skillet until golden and crisp.
Spread 100g labneh generously on the toasted bread slices.
Divide labneh toast between plates, top with shakshuka, season with sea salt and black pepper, then garnish with fresh cilantro.

recipes.title: Green Smoothie Bowl with Granola Clusters
recipes.description: Silky spinach and banana base topped with crispy granola, fresh berries, and toasted coconut.
instructions: Blend 2 cups fresh spinach, 1 large frozen banana, 1/2 cup almond milk, 1/2 cup greek yogurt, 1 tbsp honey, and 1/4 tsp vanilla extract until completely smooth.
Pour the smoothie into a wide bowl to create a thick, spoonable base.
Scatter 1/2 cup granola, 1/2 cup fresh blueberries, and 1/2 cup sliced strawberries evenly over the smoothie base.
Sprinkle 2 tbsp unsweetened coconut flakes and 1 tbsp chia seeds on top, then serve immediately.

recipes.title: Crispy Chickpea Avocado Toast with Dukkah
recipes.description: Crunchy roasted chickpeas and creamy avocado on wholegrain toast, finished with Egyptian spice blend.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Toss 240g drained chickpeas with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp cumin seeds, and 1/2 tsp sea salt until coated.
Spread chickpeas on baking tray and roast at 200°C for 12 minutes until crispy and golden.
While chickpeas roast, toast 1 tbsp sesame seeds and 1/4 tsp coriander seeds in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp roughly chopped hazelnuts to the toasted seeds and mix for 1 minute, then transfer to a small bowl.
Toast 2 slices wholegrain bread in a toaster or on a dry pan over medium heat until crispy.
Halve 1 large ripe avocado, remove pit, and mash flesh with 1 tbsp lemon juice, black pepper, and a pinch of sea salt.
Spread mashed avocado onto the toasted bread slices, top each with roasted chickpeas, sprinkle dukkah mixture, and garnish with microgreens.

recipes.title: Shakshuka with Za'atar Flatbread
recipes.description: Poached eggs in spiced tomato sauce with crispy herb-dusted flatbread.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil over medium heat and sauté 1 diced onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, and 1 tsp paprika, stirring constantly for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in 400g canned tomatoes and simmer over medium heat for 8 minutes, breaking up tomatoes with a spoon.
Season sauce with salt and black pepper to taste, then create 4 wells and crack eggs into each.
Cover and simmer over medium heat for 5–7 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks remain runny.
Meanwhile, combine 150g plain flour, 80ml water, and a pinch of salt, then knead for 1 minute into a soft dough.
Divide dough in half, roll each into a thin oval, then pan-fry over medium-high heat in 1 tbsp olive oil for 2 minutes per side.
Flip flatbreads and cook 2 more minutes, then brush with remaining 1 tbsp olive oil and sprinkle 1 tbsp za'atar on each.
Serve shakshuka in a bowl topped with 2 tbsp fresh parsley, alongside warm za'atar flatbread.

recipes.title: Miso Butter Corn Toast with Soft-Boiled Egg
recipes.description: Buttered sourdough with umami miso-corn spread, topped with jammy egg and nori.
instructions: Bring a small pot of salted water to a boil, add 2 large eggs, and simmer for 6 minutes for jammy yolks.
Meanwhile, heat 15g butter over medium heat in a small pan and toast 120g corn kernels for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in 1.5 tbsp miso paste and 1 tsp soy sauce until well combined, then remove from heat.
Toast 2 slices sourdough bread until crispy and golden, then spread with 15g butter.
Divide miso-corn mixture between toasted slices, then top each with 1 soft-boiled egg.
Crumble 1 nori sheet over both toasts, sprinkle 1 tbsp sesame seeds, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Venezuelan Arepa with Black Beans & Queso Fresco
recipes.description: Crispy corn cakes filled with seasoned beans, cheese, and avocado slices.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil over medium heat and sauté 1 minced garlic clove for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add 240g drained black beans and 1 tsp cumin, stirring over medium heat for 4 minutes until warm.
Season beans with salt and black pepper to taste, mash roughly with a fork, then set aside.
In a bowl, combine 200g cornmeal, 250ml water, and 1 tsp salt, stirring until a thick, uniform dough forms.
Let dough rest for 3 minutes, then divide into 4 equal balls and flatten each into a 1cm-thick disc.
Heat remaining 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then pan-fry arepas for 5 minutes per side until golden.
Flip arepas carefully and fry the second side for 5 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Split each warm arepa horizontally using a knife, then fill with mashed beans, 80g crumbled queso fresco, and avocado slices.
Serve filled arepas immediately with lime wedges for squeezing over top.

Create 4 small wells in the sauce and crack 4 large eggs into each well, then cover and simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes until whites set.
Garnish with 2 tbsp fresh chopped cilantro and serve immediately with 2 slices crusty bread.

recipes.title: Spanish Tortilla with Tomato Salad
recipes.description: Crispy potato and egg frittata served with fresh tomato and basil salad, rustic elegance.
instructions: Heat 6 tbsp olive oil in a 10-inch non-stick skillet over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add 400g thinly sliced potatoes and 1 small thinly sliced onion, then cook over medium heat for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender.
Season the potatoes with salt and black pepper to taste.
Whisk 6 large eggs in a bowl and pour over the potatoes in the skillet.
Cook over medium heat for 6 minutes without stirring until the bottom and sides set but center is still soft.
Slide the tortilla onto a plate, then carefully flip it back into the skillet to cook the other side over medium heat for 3 minutes until set.
Transfer tortilla to a serving plate and let rest for 2 minutes.
Combine 250g sliced tomatoes and 10 torn basil leaves in a small bowl.
Drizzle tomato salad with 1 tbsp red wine vinegar and 0.5 tsp sea salt, then toss gently.
Slice tortilla into 4 wedges and serve warm with the tomato salad on the side.

recipes.title: Shakshuka with Herb Yogurt & Whole Grain Toast
recipes.description: Poached eggs in spiced tomato sauce with fresh herbs, creamy yogurt drizzle, and crusty toast.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 medium diced onion and 2 minced garlic cloves, sauté until softened and fragrant.
Stir in 1 tsp cumin and 1/2 tsp paprika, cook for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Pour in 400g crushed tomatoes, season with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp black pepper, simmer over medium heat.
Create 3 small wells in the sauce and crack 3 large eggs into them, cover and poach until whites set.
Toast 2 slices whole grain bread until golden brown.
Spoon 3 tbsp greek yogurt onto plates, top with shakshuka, and garnish with 2 tbsp cilantro and 1 tbsp parsley.
Serve immediately with toasted whole grain bread on the side.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Bánh Mì Toast with Pickled Vegetables
recipes.description: Crispy sourdough with creamy avocado, pickled carrots, radish, cilantro, and soft scrambled eggs.
instructions: Combine 1 medium julienned carrot and 3 small sliced radishes in a bowl with 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, and 1/2 tsp salt; set aside to pickle.
Heat 1 tbsp butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat, whisk 2 large eggs with a pinch of black pepper and pour in.
Stir gently and cook the eggs until just set but still soft, then transfer to a plate.
Toast 2 slices sourdough bread until crispy and golden brown.
Mash 1/2 ripe avocado with 1/2 lime juice and spread on toasted bread.
Layer soft eggs, pickled vegetables, and 2 tbsp fresh cilantro on avocado toast.
Sprinkle 1/4 tsp chili flakes on top and serve immediately.
